claims: The "Arctic Frost" investigation is a Senate Judiciary Committee-led probe into a 2022 FBI inquiry regarding the 2020 election "false electors scheme".
The "Arctic Frost" investigation is led by Senator Chuck Grassley.

The "Arctic Frost" investigation alleges that the FBI and Special Counsel Jack Smith improperly targeted hundreds of Republicans, including members of Congress, via surveillance and phone record subpoenas.
The 2022 FBI inquiry was opened in April 2022 by the FBI.
The 2022 FBI inquiry was later incorporated into Special Counsel Jack Smith's case against Donald Trump.
The "Arctic Frost" oversight revealed the FBI and DOJ obtained records for at least nine Republican members of Congress (eight senators and one House member).
Over 400 Republican-affiliated organizations and individuals were reportedly targeted, according to Senator Chuck Grassley.
Senator Grassley and Senator Ron Johnson are conducting an investigation into the FBI’s actions.
Senator Grassley and Senator Ron Johnson aim to release records and hold hearings in 2026.
"Arctic-FROST" is a separate, unrelated research project focused on Arctic sustainability based at the University of Northern Iowa.
